subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-discovery of agent configurations from external workspaces

question: Should OpenClaw add core trusted workspace-agent config discovery, keep agent registration explicit, or leave discovery to external operator tooling?
rationale: The request is useful, but it changes config shape, filesystem trust, and live routing/session semantics; those boundaries require maintainer product and security intent before implementation.

options.title: Design Trusted Discovery First
options.body: Specify trusted roots, file names, precedence, validation, hot-reload behavior, and security proof before accepting an implementation.

options.title: Keep Explicit Registration
options.body: Continue with `agents.list`, `openclaw agents add`, and Gateway `agents.create/update/delete`, using docs or scripts for bulk setup.

options.title: External Operator Tooling
options.body: Leave workspace scanning to a plugin, script, or ClawHub package unless it exposes a missing core API.

recommendation.title: Design Trusted Discovery First
recommendation.body: Specify trusted roots, file names, precedence, validation, hot-reload behavior, and security proof before accepting an implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The explicit agent-management RPCs they introduced are the closest current owner boundary for deciding whether discovery should extend that path.
